g.text: The fee cut improves fund-level LP returns
Hypothetical $20bn fund. NPV at model inception; 15% assumed discount rate. Inputs above the rule, outputs below it.
A 15 bp fee cut saves the fund $30m a year and lifts LP IRR by about 21 bps.
The −15 bps fee rate and the +21.36 bps IRR gain are different measures of one change.
Source: Inputs!C6, C18:C19; Q4 Analysis!B6:D7. The IRR change uses full precision (21.3581 bps); OPERF's 3.75% model share scales amounts only, never the IRR.
